result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there is a minor layout issue where the bottom navigation bar overlaps the content, and a minor content issue with a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar slightly overlaps the last visible content item (the pizza image).
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin to the main content area to ensure no content is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Allow the text to wrap to a second line or use a smaller font size to display the full name, or ensure the truncation includes an ellipsis if it doesn't already.
